nom: SUNDAY RILEY C.E.O. Vitamin C Rich Hydration Moisturizing Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report the cream absorbs fully without leaving a visible or greasy film, even under makeup.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including menopausal and desert-dry skin, describe it as rich, deeply hydrating and long-lasting, though one with dry skin reports flaking, burning and a rubber-like feel.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it hydrates without making them look oily and works well as a daytime moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report burning, redness, flaking, hives or breakouts (some attributing it to fragrance or citrus), while others with self-described sensitive or reactive skin say it calms redness, aids rosacea, or works well if introduced slowly.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin (40s-60s, some post-menopause) report visible reduction in wrinkles, age spots and dullness, with several using it specifically as a rich night cream for added hydration.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report visible softening of wrinkles, age spots and sun damage-related discoloration over time, with brighter, tighter-looking skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, long-lasting hydration and relief from flaking or dry, thirsty skin; a few dissent, saying moisture faded quickly, especially in winter, or that it did not hydrate as expected for the price.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers say it visibly reduces redness and helps manage rosacea flare-ups; others report the opposite, developing new redness, itching or irritation after application.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers with compromised or reactive skin describe burning, stinging or flaking suggesting barrier irritation, while others with reactive or rosacea-prone skin report no issues and even soothing effects.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of sunspots, dark spots, melasma and post-blemish marks with regular use; one reviewer reports the opposite, developing new brown spots on cheeks, jawline and near the ears after about a week.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including acne-prone and oily/combination skin, report no new breakouts and faster healing of blemishes; others describe new breakouts, cystic-feeling bumps or hives, some attributing this to the fragrance.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination-skin reviewers say it does not add shine or clog pores and looks matte-to-glowing rather than greasy under makeup.

aspects.libelle: Poor absorption on dry, unprepped skin

extraits.texte: This has been my go to day cream for 5 years now. I had lots of discoloration and dullness, and my face was looking old. I started using this from an Ipsy bag promotion and I have been repurchasing it since. It works great to clear orange sallowness and moderate melasma. It moisturizes my desert dry 50+ skin all day. I have incredibly reactive skin, and this doesn't break me out or clog my pores. I will use this faithfully until I cannot find it anymore.
I've been using Sunday Riley for almost 6 months and by far, the BEST products I've used. I suffer from rosacea open pores, and sensitive skin; noticed a huge difference in my skin within two weeks.

I have oily/ combination skin and I normally only use a serum during the daytime because most moisturizers are too heavy or leave me looking oily once I apply makeup. This one does not! It is very rich and very moisturizing, but once it absorbs you cannot see or feel it on the skin. It does take about 20 minutes to fully absorb before applying any other products or makeup, so give yourself a bit of time in your routine. I was afraid to try this one during the day but I'm so glad I did! On days that I go without makeup, my skin looks smooth and my pores look refined, almost as if I had applied a blurring primer. It has helped to soften pigmentation from sun damage. I normally get a lot of post-inflammatory pigmentation after a blemish. When I recently had a couple of blemishes, they barely left a mark and healed quickly because I was using this product. I love it! I love every Sunday Riley product I have tried, but I am truly blown away by this one. I am an esthetician and I've tried lots of products over the years. This is one for the books :) Note: This product does have a very strong smell. However it did not effect my rating whatsoever because I was so pleased with the result.

I got this in a sample bag set and I'm SO happy I didn't purchase this in full size. My skin is fairly sensitive and the scent in this is what I think is causing my skin to freak out. It's all red, dry, itchy, and have a few bumps where I didn't prior to using this. It's a shame companies feel the need to use fragrance where it just isn't needed.

extraits.titre: STAY AWAY from this product! Will ruin your face
extraits.texte: I bought several products from Sunday Riley. I started using the C.E.O Vitamin C cream and I can say is total garbage. Within a week I developed brown spots on my face on the cheeks, jaw line and around the ear. I am extremely upset to the point that I will be asking them to pay for me getting the brown spots removed. The other products I bought will go straight to the trash can. Terrible company first time I ever use a face cream that destroys your face. Several people have provided similar reviews on cream producing brown spots on face. Never again.

For reference, I'm 42 with acne prone slightly sensitive skin, minimal signs of aging. I started off my skin journey with dry skin but after going through a bottle of this cream, my skin finally feels nourished! For transparency, I also use Drunk Elephant Framboos Glycolic Night Serum once weekly and Cerave daily face wash but i've been really bad about sticking with a routine with exception of this cream. I really look forward to putting this on every morning. It is beyond amazing. It has a very light citrus scent and smells delicious. And wow does it feel luxurious when you put it on! It really hydrates well and overall i feel like my skin looks so much better after having gone through a bottle. I have tried so many creams, from high end to drug store. Nothing compares to this one for me.

This cream has a rich & sumptuous texture & really moisturizes. I have very dry skin since menopause and this is perfect! It goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly, & has a light scent. I returned the No. 7 Vitamin C Cream bc this is SO much better! LOVE!
